runtime.operatorTracking: workflow log records operatorId from admin/member session when available
runtime.multiApproval: requiredApprovals controls how many approve actions are required before review content is published
runtime.distinctApprovers: requireDistinctApprovers rejects repeated approval by the same operator in one workflow round
runtime.adminStats: workflow.stats returns todo, notification and log action aggregates for the moderation dashboard
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders workflow.stats as overview, approval diagnostics, scheduled due diagnostics and action aggregate tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.actionResultUi: ability page renders workflow.action result as a status/log/notification/approval table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.scheduledPublishUi: ability page renders workflow.scheduled-publish execution result as a bounded operation table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.statsDiagnostics: workflow.stats exposes approvalConfig and scheduledDue as read-only diagnostics, with scheduled due scanning bounded by maxListRows
runtime.nodePlan: workflow.stats exposes workflowPlan.nodes as the production flow model while keeping the existing requiredApprovals path compatible
runtime.transitionPlan: workflow.stats exposes workflowPlan.transitions with action, fromNode, toNode, permission and automatic flags
runtime.workflowPlanUi: ability page renders workflowPlan nodes and transitions as read-only tables for production acceptance
runtime.requestLimit: workflow action and scheduled publish reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
